It was my pleasure to host FSC Chairman @PatrickMcHenry, @RepFrenchHill and @RepSylviaGarcia at @MIT today for a Working Group on Artificial Intelligence. We met with professors and other field experts about the application of AI across industries, the benefits and risks of its use and implementation, and the importance of verifying data sources to ensure AI models lead to accurate outcomes. My thanks to the MIT Dean of Schwarzman College of Computing Daniel Huttenlocher, the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab and DynamoAI team, and the faculty and staff for presenting the research and data MIT has compiled on AI and its impact on our industries and society.

The explosion of AI adoption across industries has raised serious questions about implications for financial access, employment, data privacy, and intellectual property.
